newsitem.title: USA: Individual Investor sees better Q4.
newsitem.headline: Individual Investor sees better Q4.

text.p: Individual Investor Group Inc said on Tuesday it expected its operating performance to improve significantly in the fourth quarter, due to new sources of revenue.

The business information publisher, which reported a loss of $0.26 per share in the third quarter 1996 compared to a profit of $0.09 per share, said its third quarter results reflected strategic investments in advertising sales personnel, marketing efforts and the launch of new products for future growth.

Jonathan Steinberg, chairman and chief executive officer, said that as a result of these investments, "we made signifiant progress towards our goals of growing circulation, attracting higher margin consumer advertisers, increasing advertising pages and rates and introducing new products for the investing public which leverage off our in-house research capabilities."
The company, which said it was on track to generate more than $5 milion in 1996 advertising revenues, said it expected similar growth trends in advertising revenues in 1997.
